answer: Each submission hangs on the lagoon of a task receipt, and the quartz is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on invitation quota tree, burned when the recruit misbehaves, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. What survives to the knoll is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
